set.body: The plugin's hook manifest declares its events at the top level, but the loader reads them from under a top-level hooks record. The file is valid JSON, so nothing complained; the loader simply found no events and every hook silently did nothing for anyone who installed the plugin. Four of four other installed plugins use the wrapper. Incorporated from pull request 329, which found it against a real installation.
set.title: Plugin hooks never fired: the manifest was not wrapped

set.body: While shipping the Codex hooks the wrapper difference was read as a Codex quirk rather than the shared requirement it is, and a test was written asserting that the Claude manifest must not have the wrapper. That pinned the defect in place and would have failed anyone who fixed it.
set.title: A test asserted the broken hook manifest shape

set.resolution: Hook manifest wrapped; the test that asserted the flat shape corrected. Incorporated from #329.

set.body: Ship the hook manifest fix. Anyone who installed the plugin has been running without hooks; this release is what makes them fire.
